title: Spanish counterpart: number of days in a week
rationale: Paired with ml_zh_days_01, this detects language-specific inconsistency: the same basic fact must get the same answer in Spanish and in Chinese, or localization is unreliable.

prompt.content: Eres un asistente preciso. Responde en español con una sola frase corta y sin explicaciones.

notes: Language: Spanish. Expected answer token: 7, accepted as the digit 7 (as in 7 días) or the word siete. Paired with ml_zh_days_01: both ask the same fact (days per week) and expect 7, so a model that answers correctly in one language and incorrectly in the other is exposed. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: the word-boundary guard stops diecisiete from matching siete; an English answer such as 'seven' fails because the system message requires Spanish.
